class.name: FlowGraphMermaid
class.brief_description: Reads and writes a [FlowGraph] as a Mermaid flowchart ([code].mmd[/code]).

method.name: deserialize
method.description: Creates a [FlowGraph] from Mermaid [param text]. Returns [code]null[/code] and prints an error with line and message if the text can't be read. Use [method parse] to get the error instead.

method.name: get_error_line
method.description: Returns the line (starting at 1) of the error of the last [method parse], or [code]0[/code] if it succeeded.

method.name: get_error_message
method.description: Returns the error message of the last [method parse], or an empty string if it succeeded.

method.name: get_graph
method.description: Returns the graph read by the last successful [method parse], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: parse
method.description: Reads Mermaid [param text] into a new [FlowGraph] (see [method get_graph]). Returns [constant OK], or [constant ERR_PARSE_ERROR] and keeps the line and message of the error (see [method get_error_line] and [method get_error_message]).

method.name: serialize
method.description: Writes [param graph] as a Mermaid flowchart. Without [param options], the defaults of [FlowGraphMermaidOptions] are used (top-down, lossless).
